canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

scope_decision: close-price-only, substituting a close-based rolling extreme for the prototype's intraday high/low pullback range; reuses the event-recomputing bootstrap scaffold proven by RSI oversold reversal and TA Breakout v1

pullback.definition: PullbackHigh(t) = rolling 3-session maximum close, computed through close t-1 only (shift(1) before the rolling window)

forward_return.definition: R10(t) = sum of log returns over the 10 sessions following the event close

bootstrap.base_function: backend/app/research.py:wave_pull_bootstrap (event-recomputing extension shared in design with rsi_bootstrap and ta_breakout_bootstrap)
bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_mean_forward_return >= observed, plus add-one correction

correction.family_definition: eligible assets, event statistic only; placebo compared per-asset, not a second Holm-corrected family

gates.placebo_rule: event mean forward return must exceed placebo mean forward return on the same asset
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical forward-return/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked impulse threshold, pullback window, and forward horizon, matching the existing prototype's own defaults

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run
scope_exclusions.no_stop_or_target_mechanics: the prototype's own risk mechanics are not used in this no-trade event study
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol
